evidence: The paper uses percent contribution (impurity importance) from BRT models, stating "Song intensity showed the strongest relationship with month, which contributed 59%-77% of the explained deviance" and "all environmental predictors had relatively low contributions." However, these magnitude/ranking interpretations are adequately corroborated through partial dependence plots showing functional relationships. Main conclusions about seasonal song patterns are validated by independent whaling records documenting breeding timing; D call reductions during heatwaves are corroborated by measured krill density data; and the D call→song relationship is tested with linear mixed models (p=0.04), not solely on percent contribution rankings.
